name: Risk Department
description: The organisational department responsible for the ownership and management of the Risk Appetite Statement 2026.

name: Conservative Risk Appetite
description: The bank's overarching risk management approach which prioritizes financial stability, customer protection, and regulatory compliance over aggressive business growth.
context: FirstUK Bank adopts a conservative risk appetite balancing customer service delivery, business growth, and regulatory compliance.
The bank will not pursue growth at the expense of financial stability, customer protection, or regulatory compliance.

name: High-Quality Customer Service Risk
description: A risk area focused on maintaining reliable and fair banking services to achieve sustainable profitability.
context: High-Quality Customer Service — Reliable, fair banking services

name: Financial Stability Risk
description: A risk area focused on maintaining capital levels above regulatory minimums with additional buffers to ensure stability.
context: Financial Stability — Capital above regulatory minimums with buffers

name: Compliance Risk
description: A risk area with a zero-tolerance approach toward willful regulatory breaches.
context: Strong Compliance — Zero tolerance for willful regulatory breaches

name: Operational Excellence Risk
description: A risk area emphasizing the need for reliable systems, robust controls, and continuous improvement.
context: Operational Excellence — Reliable systems, robust controls, continuous improvement

name: High-Risk Lending Strategy
description: A prohibited risk strategy that the bank will not pursue in its quest for sustainable profitability.
context: We will NOT pursue: High-risk lending strategies

name: Aggressive Growth in Loss-Making Areas
description: A prohibited growth strategy involving aggressive expansion into areas that are loss-making.
context: We will NOT pursue: Aggressive growth in loss-making areas

name: Compliance and Control Shortcuts
description: A prohibited practice of taking shortcuts around established compliance frameworks or internal controls.
context: We will NOT pursue: Shortcuts around compliance or controls

name: Concentrated Exposure Risk
description: A prohibited risk scenario involving excessive exposure to single customers or specific sectors.
context: We will NOT pursue: Concentrated exposure to single customers/sectors

name: Excessive Leverage and Capital Risk
description: A prohibited risk approach involving excessive leverage or taking undue risks with the bank's capital.
context: We will NOT pursue: Excessive leverage or capital risk

name: Credit Risk
description: A risk category managed with a conservative appetite, focusing on consumer lending and mortgages while avoiding commercial lending or risky credit products.
context: FirstUK Bank focuses on consumer lending (mortgages) with strong underwriting. Does not pursue commercial lending or risky credit products.

name: Loan Loss Ratio — Threshold <0.5% annually
description: A quantitative tolerance threshold for the annual loan loss ratio within the Credit Risk category.

name: Delinquency Rate — Threshold <2% of active accounts
description: A quantitative tolerance threshold for the delinquency rate relative to active accounts.

name: Concentration Limit — No single customer >10% of capital
description: A risk appetite threshold limiting the exposure to any single customer to 10% of the bank's capital.
context: Concentration: No single customer >10% of capital

name: Mortgage LTV — Maximum <80%
description: The maximum allowable Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio for mortgage products.

name: Mortgages
description: The primary consumer lending product focused on by FirstUK Bank, subject to mandatory credit scoring and affordability assessments.
context: FirstUK Bank focuses on consumer lending (mortgages)

name: Operational Risk
description: A risk category with a 'Low' appetite. The bank prioritizes operational reliability, customer trust, and regulatory compliance, investing in systems, training, and controls to prevent failures.
context: FirstUK Bank prioritizes operational reliability, customer trust, and regulatory compliance.

name: Annual Operational Losses — Tolerance <£50,000
description: A quantitative tolerance threshold for annual operational losses, set at less than £50,000.

name: Major Incidents — Tolerance <1 per year
description: A quantitative tolerance threshold for the frequency of major incidents, limited to fewer than one per year.

name: System Outages — Tolerance <8 hours per year
description: A quantitative tolerance threshold for total system outage duration, limited to less than 8 hours per year.

name: Process Errors — Tolerance <0.5% error rate
description: A quantitative tolerance threshold for the rate of process errors, set at less than 0.5%.

name: Compliance & Regulatory Risk
description: A risk category with a minimal/zero appetite. The bank operates under close regulatory oversight where any breach is viewed as damaging to the bank's reputation and license.
context: FirstUK Bank operates under close regulatory oversight. Any regulatory breach damages reputation and license.

name: Regulatory Breaches Tolerance — Zero willful violations
description: The tolerance threshold for regulatory breaches, specified as zero willful violations.

name: KYC/AML Non-Compliance Tolerance — 0%
description: The tolerance threshold for non-compliance regarding Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) requirements.

name: Customer Protection Breaches Tolerance — 0%
description: The tolerance threshold for breaches related to customer protection.

name: Disclosure Violations Tolerance — Zero
description: The tolerance threshold for violations related to regulatory disclosures.

name: Fraud Risk
description: A risk category with a 'Low' appetite. The bank is committed to protecting customers and assets through investments in prevention systems and monitoring.
context: FirstUK Bank invests in fraud prevention systems and monitoring. Committed to protecting customers and bank assets from fraud.

name: Annual Fraud Loss — Threshold <£100,000 (0.3% of revenue)
description: A quantitative tolerance threshold for annual fraud losses, capped at £100,000 or 0.3% of revenue.

name: Fraud Detection Rate — Threshold >96%
description: A quantitative tolerance threshold requiring a fraud detection rate of greater than 96%.

name: Customer Reimbursement — Threshold <£30k annually
description: A quantitative tolerance threshold for annual customer reimbursements, capped at £30,000.

name: Internal Fraud — Zero Tolerance
description: A strict zero-tolerance threshold regarding internal fraud events.

name: Reputational Risk
description: A risk category with a 'Low' appetite, focused on maintaining customer trust and operational reliability. The bank manages this risk through customer service, compliance, and transparency.
context: FirstUK Bank's brand depends on customer trust and operational reliability.

name: Major Complaints — Tolerance <2 per 1,000 accounts
description: A quantitative tolerance threshold for major complaints, set at fewer than 2 per 1,000 accounts.

name: Regulatory Complaints — Tolerance <1 per 1,000 accounts
description: A quantitative tolerance threshold for regulatory complaints, set at fewer than 1 per 1,000 accounts.

name: Media Incidents — Tolerance Zero negative incidents
description: An aspirational tolerance threshold aiming for zero negative media incidents.

name: Customer Trust (NPS) — Target >70
description: A performance metric for customer trust measured via Net Promoter Score, with a target value greater than 70.

name: Capital Risk
description: A risk category managed with a conservative appetite to ensure the bank can absorb losses, fund growth, and meet regulatory requirements without compromising stability for shareholder returns.
context: FirstUK Bank maintains strong capital ratios to absorb losses, fund growth, and meet regulatory requirements.

name: Capital Ratio (Pillar 1) — Minimum >15%, Target 18%+
description: The Pillar 1 Capital Ratio threshold with a minimum requirement of 15% and a target of 18% or higher.

name: Leverage Ratio — >5%
description: The Leverage Ratio threshold set at greater than 5% in accordance with Basel III standards.

name: Capital Adequacy Buffer — 3%+ above minimum
description: The required capital adequacy buffer maintained at 3% or more above the minimum requirement.

name: Technology & Cybersecurity Risk
description: A risk category with a low appetite, focusing on the bank's dependence on reliable technology, security, resilience, and disaster recovery to protect customer data and maintain service availability.
context: FirstUK Bank depends on reliable technology. Invests in security, resilience, and disaster recovery to maintain service availability and protect customer data.

name: System Availability — SLA 99.8%
description: The service level agreement (SLA) threshold for system availability within the Technology & Cybersecurity risk tolerance framework.

name: Major Data Breach — Zero Tolerance
description: The bank's absolute tolerance level regarding major data breaches.

name: Cybersecurity Incidents — <1 per year
description: The annual tolerance threshold for the number of cybersecurity incidents.

name: Unplanned Downtime — <2 hours per year
description: The annual tolerance threshold for unplanned system downtime.

name: Liquidity Risk
description: A risk category managed with a conservative appetite to ensure the bank can meet customer withdrawals and operational needs without relying on external funding.
context: FirstUK Bank maintains strong liquidity to meet customer withdrawals and operational needs. Does not rely on external funding.

name: Loan-to-Deposit Ratio — Tolerance <90%
description: A liquidity tolerance threshold specifying that the Loan-to-Deposit Ratio must remain below 90%.

name: Liquid Assets Buffer — Tolerance 30 days+ operating expenses
description: A liquidity tolerance threshold requiring a buffer of liquid assets sufficient to cover at least 30 days of operating expenses.
context: Liquid Assets Buffer: 30 days+ operating expenses

name: Maturity Mismatch — Tolerance <6 months average
description: A liquidity tolerance threshold limiting the average maturity mismatch to less than 6 months.

name: KYC and Screening Risk
description: Risk associated with account opening processes. The bank's appetite allows for account opening provided there is strong KYC and quality screening.
context: Account opening with strong KYC, quality screening

name: Mortgage Lending Risk
description: Risk associated with mortgage lending. Appetite is limited to lending with affordability checks and reasonable Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratios, while high LTV mortgages are considered inconsistent with appetite.
context: Mortgage lending with affordability checks, reasonable LTV
High-risk lending (commercial loans, high LTV mortgages)

name: Pricing Strategy Risk
description: Risk related to the bank's pricing approach. The bank maintains a conservative, competitive pricing strategy and avoids predatory pricing.

name: Compliance and Fraud Systems Investment Risk
description: Risk related to the adequacy of systems for fraud and compliance. Investment in these systems is viewed as consistent with the bank's risk appetite.
context: Investment in compliance and fraud systems

name: Capital Stability and Growth Risk
description: Risk regarding the bank's capital position. The bank prioritizes capital retention for stability and growth, while excessive leverage or capital risk is prohibited.
context: Capital retention for stability and growth

name: Commercial Lending Risk
description: Risk associated with commercial loans, which are explicitly categorized as high-risk lending and inconsistent with the bank's risk appetite.
context: High-risk lending (commercial loans, high LTV mortgages)

name: Aggressive Growth Risk
description: Risk arising from rapid expansion that may sacrifice internal controls or regulatory compliance.

name: Regulatory Compliance Risk
description: Risk of regulatory violations or the taking of shortcuts to bypass regulatory requirements, which is strictly inconsistent with appetite.

name: Customer Exposure Limit — Threshold <10% of Capital
description: A quantitative limit on customer exposure to prevent concentration risk. Exposure exceeding 10% of capital is considered inconsistent with risk appetite.

name: Control and Staffing Risk
description: Risk associated with inadequate staffing levels or weak internal controls.

name: Risk Team
description: The internal department responsible for flagging issues when proposed decisions conflict with the bank's risk appetite.

name: Business Unit
description: The operational unit required to provide rationale and justification when a proposed decision conflicts with risk appetite.

name: Executive Committee
description: The senior leadership body, comprising the CRO, CFO, and CEO, responsible for reviewing risk appetite conflicts.

name: Board Risk Committee
description: The board-level committee that must be notified if a conflict with risk appetite is deemed significant.

name: Risk Appetite Conflict Escalation Process
description: A multi-step escalation procedure triggered when a proposed decision conflicts with risk appetite, involving flagging, rationale provision, executive review, and board notification.
context: If Proposed Decision Conflicts with Risk Appetite:

name: Documented Decision and Justification Recording
description: The formal requirement to record the final decision and the accompanying justification following an escalation regarding risk appetite conflicts.

name: Loan loss ratio — Threshold >0.5%
description: A quarterly monitored risk metric with a threshold of greater than 0.5%. Exceeding this threshold triggers a review of underwriting criteria.

name: Operational incidents — Threshold >4/month
description: A monthly monitored metric tracking operational incidents. If incidents exceed 4 per month, a root cause investigation is required.

name: Compliance violations — Threshold >0
description: A monthly monitored metric for compliance violations. Any violation (greater than 0) requires immediate remediation.

name: Fraud loss — Threshold >£25k/q
description: A quarterly monitored metric for fraud losses. Losses exceeding £25,000 per quarter trigger an enhancement of detection rules.

name: System availability — Threshold <99.8%
description: A daily monitored metric for system availability. Availability falling below 99.8% triggers an emergency response.

name: Capital ratio — Threshold <15%
description: A daily monitored capital ratio. If the ratio falls below 15%, the matter must be escalated to the Board.

name: Customer complaints — Threshold >2/1000
description: A monthly monitored metric for customer complaints. A rate exceeding 2 per 1000 triggers a process review.

name: Capital Ratio
description: A quantitative risk metric monitored on a daily reporting frequency.

name: System Availability
description: A performance and risk metric monitored on a daily reporting frequency.

name: Fraud Incidents
description: A metric tracking fraud occurrences monitored on a daily reporting frequency.

name: Operational Incidents
description: A metric tracking operational incidents monitored on a weekly reporting frequency.

name: Compliance Alerts
description: A metric tracking compliance alerts monitored on a weekly reporting frequency.

name: KRI Summary to Management
description: A monthly summary of Key Risk Indicators provided to management.

name: Operational Losses
description: A metric tracking operational losses monitored on a monthly reporting frequency.

name: Full Risk Dashboard to Board Risk Committee
description: A comprehensive risk dashboard reported to the Board Risk Committee on a quarterly basis.
context: Quarterly: Full risk dashboard to Board Risk Committee

name: Comprehensive Risk Assessment to Board
description: An annual comprehensive risk assessment reported to the Board.
context: Annually: Comprehensive risk assessment to Board

name: Board Risk Committee
description: The governance body responsible for reviewing the quarterly full risk dashboard.
context: Quarterly: Full risk dashboard to Board Risk Committee

name: Board
description: The primary governance body receiving the annual comprehensive risk assessment.
context: Annually: Comprehensive risk assessment to Board

name: Board of Directors Approval Authority for Review & Updates
description: The Board of Directors is designated as the formal approval authority for the review and updates of this document, which is subject to an annual review cycle.

name: Chief Risk Officer Approval of Document
description: Formal sign-off and approval of the document provided by the Chief Risk Officer on 2026-01-15.
context: Approved by: Chief Risk Officer — Date: 2026-01-15

name: Board Risk Committee Approval of Document
description: Formal sign-off and approval of the document provided by the Board Risk Committee on 2026-01-15.
context: Approved by: Board Risk Committee — Date: 2026-01-15

name: Board of Directors Approval of Document
description: Formal sign-off and approval of the document provided by the Board of Directors on 2026-01-15.
context: Approved by: Board of Directors — Date: 2026-01-15

name: Board Risk Committee
description: The governance body responsible for the review and approval of risk-related documentation.

name: Board of Directors
description: The primary governing body of FirstUK Bank providing final approval for the document.
